drafts.body:
The mobile composer now releases inactive targets and uses a packed color target when its grade and effects permit it; the scene target and active ScreenFX retain HDR. The [native WebGL capture and original six-criterion mapping](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/72c799fee36173e1255e023bad7c9a19605ad2b1/reports/issue-resolution-20261029/642-native-webgl-resource-capture-98/README.md) records identical original and instrumented 48-case results at source `98ccd1c6ea143ea402319c6637cd1bca5d075a6e`. The native observer recorded 385 calls without drops, including 109 texture allocations, 88 framebuffer attachments and 88 deletions; all 64 texture IDs linked to the compared targets were allocated, attached, deleted and subsequently returned `isTexture` false. The actual eligible format was R11F_G11F_B10F, not RGBA8. At equal dimensions, the eligible packed-plus-HDR pair has 25% lower estimated color bytes than two RGBA16F targets; active effects used two HDR targets. Short touch-emulated LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH local Turf samples observed the eligible pair in movement and null lazy menu targets, not a whole-match savings rate.

The 48-case comparison passed: the 33 active/negative-grade HDR rows were exact and the 15 packed idle rows had maximum mean 0.376953 and p99 2, within the engineering-accepted mean ≤1.25 / p99 ≤3 budget. The issue owner did not personally approve those numbers. The mapping also records orientation/dynamic scaling, release and disposal, context restoration, and desktop/fallback HDR controls and their separate source epochs. Earlier 39c Turf and browser controls retain their own identity; selected relevant components match the 98 capture, not the entire application graph. [Later component identity and scoped validation](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/72c799fee36173e1255e023bad7c9a19605ad2b1/reports/issue-resolution-20261029/final73-scoped-validation/README.md) connects the retained evidence to the final code epoch without relabeling older runs.

These controlled software-browser results do not establish physical VRAM, FPS, whole-match savings or physical-device stability. Physical-device verification was waived. Final required CI for [PR head `1cba8c73`](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/commit/1cba8c73e79565757f051bb106c6076440ca97d9): [run 40957522742](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/actions/runs/40957522742) — SUCCESS on the exact head: core 1/1, CPU shards 8/8, browser suites 7/7 and the strict final `validate` gate passed. All 36 workflows are terminal (35 success, 1 unchanged permitted skip), with no failures, cancellations, missing workflow or missing Actions check family. No test or workflow skip was added for this result..

The current PR head `1cba8c73e79565757f051bb106c6076440ca97d9` was checked against all 1,550 application inputs and all 2,267 artifacts of the existing `5d8b116b9dbb804c21aaa0f92fadd5e9298f1f7a7ecd0a81c3fcc42541524a5a` build. This is build identity evidence, not a new browser capture.

The verified code and evidence are available through PR #1914, which remains unmerged under the existing main-merge policy.

Correction to [my earlier status comment](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/issues/1431#issuecomment-6489904468): the first predicted right-hand display connection described there as missing was a historical limitation and is now implemented. The old evidence remains unchanged. Native physical prediction and obstructed fallback remain authoritative; the eligible display/FX connection uses the same-tick posed muzzle with a full-segment cover check.

The [original four-criterion acceptance mapping](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/72c799fee36173e1255e023bad7c9a19605ad2b1/reports/issue-resolution-20261029/issue1431-current2b/README.md) covers actual Quad and Explosher first/steady births at 30/60/120 Hz, up/down aim and wall OBB; aimReady/full-aim/LOS; damage, speed, ink, cadence and network serialization; and current-main/#1277 geometry. Its `2b01cd7efbca260a611165b1e3887ff48062ccd5` software run recorded 36 conditions, 288 births, 147 actual draws, 120 checked native-volume connections and 75 diagnostic images. The first predicted right display endpoint error was zero at each tested rate while the physical birth remained authoritative. Repeated-hit and authority controls are separate from the images.

The [later browser run](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/72c799fee36173e1255e023bad7c9a19605ad2b1/reports/issue-resolution-20261029/pr1914-ci-reconciliation/README.md) used source `550b5a3f49f40cf8ab913ea1687b7074af11e3e9`, recorded the same matrix dimensions and 75 diagnostic images, and reported no page, request or accepted-draw GL errors. The earlier and later images retain their separate source epochs; neither is a new capture at `1cba8c73`. [Later component identity and scoped validation](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/blob/72c799fee36173e1255e023bad7c9a19605ad2b1/reports/issue-resolution-20261029/final73-scoped-validation/README.md) preserves those distinctions. These are controlled software diagnostics with sparse draws, not retail-aperture, whole-match or physical-device certification. Physical-device verification was waived. Final required CI for [PR head `1cba8c73`](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/commit/1cba8c73e79565757f051bb106c6076440ca97d9): [run 40957522742](https://github.com/rhgrive3/actions/actions/runs/40957522742) — SUCCESS on the exact head: core 1/1, CPU shards 8/8, browser suites 7/7 and the strict final `validate` gate passed. All 36 workflows are terminal (35 success, 1 unchanged permitted skip), with no failures, cancellations, missing workflow or missing Actions check family. No test or workflow skip was added for this result..

The current PR head `1cba8c73e79565757f051bb106c6076440ca97d9` was checked against all 1,550 application inputs and all 2,267 artifacts of the existing `5d8b116b9dbb804c21aaa0f92fadd5e9298f1f7a7ecd0a81c3fcc42541524a5a` build. This is build identity evidence, not a new browser capture.
